snippet.title: Crow's Curse - Gamescom 2025 demo gameplay
snippet.description:
Wishlist now:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2471330/Cathedral_Crows_Curse
GOG: https://www.gog.com/en/game/cathedral_crows_curse

Showcasing a few minutes of early gameplay from Cathedral: Crow's Curse as shown on Gamescom 2025. Please note that everything in this video is early and is subject to change.

Step back into the world of Cathedral - or rather, step into its origins. In this adventure, play as Crow, one of the Shade Sentinels and discover the cause behind the curse of Shade Forest.

Follow us for more updates:

Twitter/X: https://twitter.com/dborngames
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/decemberborngames
Website: https://www.crows-curse.com/
Bluesky: @Decemberborn
